name: Hugeicons with WordPress Overview
summary: Docs page on installing Hugeicons icons in WordPress, free via the plugin or as Pro with Elementor widgets.
description: Setup guide for the Hugeicons icon system in WordPress: the free plugin ships 6,000+ icons in one style (Stroke Rounded) for the Block Editor and shortcodes, while the Pro addon and the Elementor plugin unlock 60,000+ icons across 10 styles plus four dedicated widgets (Icon Button, Icon Box, Icon List, FAQ). Lists prerequisites (WordPress 5.0+, PHP 7.4+) and the API endpoint the plugins call for icon metadata.
contains: free plugin: 6,000+ icons in 1 style (Stroke Rounded)
Elementor plugin with 4 widgets: Icon Button, Icon Box, Icon List, FAQ
plugins call https://hugeicons.com/api for icon metadata
